subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `after_compaction` plugin hooks permanently gain a current-session-scoped deferred `resetSession(reason?)` API across OpenClaw and native harness compaction paths?
rationale: This is a new plugin contract that can archive and replace persistent session state; repository policy requires owner intent for the API boundary even though the implementation has been narrowed and hardened.

options.title: Approve the narrow contract
options.body: Keep the after-compaction-only API, document its availability and deferred failure semantics, complete direct Codex source review, and require exact live reset proof before merge.

options.title: Keep reset policy internal
options.body: Remove the public hook API and implement the desired post-compaction recovery as a core or context-engine-owned policy instead.

options.title: Pause the capability
options.body: Close or defer the PR if plugin-triggered session rotation is not an intended supported contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Keep the after-compaction-only API, document its availability and deferred failure semantics, complete direct Codex source review, and require exact live reset proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this owner to both the Gateway session-reset lifecycle and decisions about which memory/plugin capabilities belong in core.
